title: Pour Water Between Buckets to Make Water Levels Equal
goal: Find the highest common water level achievable when transfers lose a percentage.
strategy: For a proposed level, excess water above it becomes supply after loss, while deficits below it are demand. Binary search the boundary where effective supply can still fill every deficit.
